en: Changed skill folders, command files and workflow commands in the `anthropic-skills` or `claude-ai` namespace to no longer load; a plugin so named still loads but yields name ties to synced skills
zh: 变更 `anthropic-skills` 或 `claude-ai` 命名空间下的 skill 文件夹、命令文件和工作流命令，使其不再加载；同名 plugin 仍会加载，但会与同步的 skills 产生名称冲突
